- scheme: A (this is a certificate of conformity under OIML-CS... actually R76/1992 predates OIML CS, but the schema asks scheme (A|B). This is a standard OIML certificate of conformity — historically these are "Scheme A" style? Actually the OIML CS has scheme A (certificate of conformity issued by issuing authority based on test reports) and scheme B (type evaluation then MAA). Traditional R76 certificates are typically Scheme A. Hmm, but do we know? The cert says "Issuing Authority NL1" which suggests the older system of issuing authorities. I'll say scheme "A" — it's a certificate of conformity with associated test reports, which matches scheme A. Given ambiguity, I could omit, but the schema wants it. I'll include "A".

The certified type is DS-200 which is a complete instrument. Module designation: null or "Not applicable". The cert doesn't explicitly state module. I'll leave null or omit. Actually the description mentions the type-approval certificate T7604 and documentation folder.
- description: "This Certificate attests the conformity..." — the description field is free-text description of the type if present. The identification is "Non-automatic weighing instrument, Type: DS-200". I could put a brief description. There's no detailed description beyond that. I could mention that test reports cover Indicator DI-200 and load cells P, K, M, N.

Components: The test reports mention Indicator type DI-200 and load cells types P, K, M, N. These are sub-assemblies of the DS-200. Should I record them as components? The cert names them in test reports. Rule 6: components for complex instruments. I think it's reasonable to include:
- role: "Indicator", type_designations: ["DI-200"]
- role: "Load cell", type_designations: ["P"], alternatives: null
- role: "Load cell", type_designations: ["K"]
- role: "Load cell", type_designations: ["M"]
- role: "Load cell", type_designations: ["N"]

The load cell types P, K, M, N are alternatives (any of these can be used). I could mark alternatives "OR" within each. Hmm, they're separate entries. Maybe combine as one component with alternatives "OR": {"role": "Load cell", "type_designations": ["P", "K", "M", "N"], "alternatives": "OR"}. That seems cleaner since a DS-200 would use one of the load cell types.
